q: The excellent yufts, which are peculiar to Russia, are well known in Europe, and are in great demand. They have also the art of preparing several other sorts of leather, of extraordinary quality, such as red, yellow and black saffians […]
1819, Henry Alexander Scammell Dearborn, A Memoir on the Commerce and Navigation of the Black Sea:
About 250,000 poods of yuft are prepared annually, of which about 150,000 poods are red yuft, manufactured chiefly for foreign markets.
